results.name: Handsome man in casual clothes in A-pose 86
results.description:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. This model was processed through Reality Capture and retopologized via ZRemesher within Zbrush. It has animation ready topology wrapped on top of the scan in Wrap3. 

This is a true human size detailed model of a  hadsome man dressed in casual style. The model is captured in the A-pose with mesh ready for rigging and animation in all most usable 3d software. 

**Technical characteristics:**

* digital double scan model
* low-poly model
* fully quad topology
* sufficiently clean
* edge Loops based
* ready for subdivision
* non-overlapping UV map
* ready for animation
* 16K texture color map
* PBR textures 8K/4K resolution: Normal, Displacement, Roughness maps
* 16K Albedo map resolution
Download package includes OBJ file, which is applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc.

**3D EVERYTHING**

results.name: 90s Survival Horror Protagonist (PSX Style)
results.description:
A retro-inspired, low-poly character model designed in the classic PS1 / PSX aesthetic. This character pays homage to the atmosphere of early survival horror titles like Silent Hill (Harry Mason style), featuring crunchy textures and a deliberate vertex-snapping-friendly topology.
Originally created as a custom commission for **Patrik Starlive**, now available for the community.

**Technical Specifications:**

**Low Poly: Only 744 triangles (482 faces), making it incredibly lightweight for any engine.**

**Textures: Single 256x256 diffuse map for that genuine late-90s pixelated look.**

*Perfect for:
Retro horror projects (PS1-style).
Mobile games with a vintage look.
PSX-style shaders and "vertex wobble" experiments.*

results.name: Shirt (Scott Alt 2) - Character Clothes (Free)
results.description:
The Sketchfab Store is dead, long live the Sketchfab Store. All free models will still be available for download through Sketchfab. All paid models will be available for sale on Gumroad and inspectable via Sketchfab. 

---
Shirt: Scott Alt 2 - A comfortable button-down plaid shirt, part of a a casual everyday look, featuring rolled-up sleeves and snap fasteners. 

--- 
standard specs - 

Fresh, crisp quads, mid-poly resolution. Main texture: 4096 diffuse, 4096 normal, 1024 specular. Secondary texture: 4096 diffuse, 2048 normal, 1024 specular. It's debatable whether or not this style qualifies as PBR. It’s high-res, but not hyperrealistic. Partly hand-painted, partly photo-ref materials. Use it in any way that works for you.

FBX format, rigged, includes the rest of the armature. My bone names are standardized, but each character has their own custom skeleton (don’t we all?) 

--- 

WIP timelapse: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=txYj4UDl-_s
